reason: A is the better proposal because interface-mediated dislocation activation is physically plausible for FCC/BCC nanoscale HEA multilayers and can be tested by correlating controlled interface changes with creep and in situ dislocation activity. B is more specific, but it largely transfers the cited optimum-negative-misfit result from a γ/γ′ high-entropy superalloy to a different FCC/BCC architecture, while neither establishing climb dominance nor offering an unconfounded way to vary misfit independently of composition.
